about: The hike area as a playground: everything named within the area box, the points on and off the route, and the branch options at each camp and junction. Distances are measured on real OSM way geometry (research/_coosa_osm.geojson, ODbL); climb and walking time use the same opentopodata elevation + Tobler model as days.json, derated for a group with packs (0.85 x 0.85) or daypacks (0.85). CONDITION OF ANYTHING OFF THE PLANNED ROUTE IS UNCONFIRMED: these are mapped lines, not trail reports. Panning legality everywhere here is AMBER — no ranger has confirmed any creek (CALLS.md #1).

nodes.label: Coosa Backcountry Trailhead (Vogel State Park)
nodes.note: Mile 0 of the 12.9 mi Coosa Backcountry Trail loop. Park inside Vogel (ParkPass).

nodes.label: Burnett Gap (CBT mile 1.02)
nodes.note: Burnett Creek Trail drops north from here to Burnett Creek Road.

nodes.label: WOLF-X — West Fork Wolf Creek / FS 107 crossing (CBT mile 3.37)
nodes.note: Where truck 1 parks. FS 107 (West Wolf Creek Road) is open to vehicles — owner, first-hand, 2026-10-05. Last water before the climb: fill 2 L each.

nodes.label: Locust Stake Gap (CBT mile 4.71)
nodes.note: On the climb from WOLF-X to Calf Stomp Gap. No water, no junction.

nodes.label: Calf Stomp Gap (CBT mile 5.91)
nodes.note: The hub of the area: Coosa Backcountry Trail, Calf Stomp Road (FS 108) and Roaring Fork Trail all meet here. The design-doc coordinate agrees with the mapped trail within 35 m.

nodes.label: Calf Stump Branch camp — night 1
nodes.note: On the Coosa Backcountry Trail 0.4 mi past Calf Stomp Gap, where it crosses Calf Stump Branch. About 400 m from the nearest road. Water: the branch (headwater, October flow UNCONFIRMED).

nodes.label: Leave-trail point above DROP-IN (Roaring Fork Trail)
nodes.note: Where the route leaves the ridge: OFF-TRAIL, about 0.4 mi and 550 ft of descent at roughly 25%. Pick the line down the spur, not a hollow. All Forest Service land.

nodes.label: CAMP-U — night 2, upper East Fork Coosa Creek
nodes.note: About 2,875 ft, on the only reach of the East Fork with no road beside it (above 34.79824, -83.97825). Nearest road point about 670 m away across a 500 ft slope. Water: the creek; headwater, October flow UNCONFIRMED — if it is a trickle move down toward 34.7958, -83.9792.

nodes.label: LOWER reach — the last pan
nodes.note: Flatter water, inside of bends. Still 500 m above the road end.

nodes.label: Where the road starts (34.79824, -83.97825)
nodes.note: Duncan Ridge Conn begins here and runs beside the creek. Nothing below this point is road-free. This is the nearest a vehicle can get to CAMP-U.

nodes.label: Duncan Ridge Conn / Bowers Road junction
nodes.note: Jones Branch and Roaring Fork join the East Fork near here.

nodes.label: Owltown Gap (Bowers Road / FS 298 trailhead)
nodes.note: Where truck 2 is staged Friday evening and where the hike ends Monday.

nodes.label: East Fork Forest Service boundary (34.80637, -83.95980)
nodes.note: DO NOT PAN BELOW THIS POINT. Below it the East Fork is private for most of the way to the mouth.

branches.label: Coosa Backcountry Trail up to Burnett Gap
branches.ends_at: Burnett Gap
branches.water: Wolf Creek at the park; nothing on the climb.
branches.note: Not used on this trip — Saturday starts by truck at WOLF-X. Here for anyone who wants to walk the whole loop from the park.

branches.label: Burnett Creek Trail down to Burnett Creek Road
branches.ends_at: Burnett Creek Road (a forest road a truck can reach)
branches.water: Burnett Creek, alongside most of the way down.
branches.note: Mapped path only, condition UNCONFIRMED. The quickest way off the ridge on the Vogel side.

branches.label: Coosa Backcountry Trail on to WOLF-X
branches.ends_at: WOLF-X (West Fork Wolf Creek / FS 107 crossing)
branches.water: West Fork Wolf Creek at WOLF-X.

branches.label: FS 107 (West Wolf Creek Road) out to the paved road
branches.ends_at: Wolf Pen Gap Road (paved)
branches.water: West Fork Wolf Creek beside the road for the first stretch.
branches.note: FS 107 is open to vehicles (owner, first-hand, 2026-10-05), so truck 1 sits here all weekend — this is a walk only if the truck is gone.

branches.label: West Fork Wolf Creek, the National Forest reach
branches.ends_at: the Forest Service boundary at 34.79131, -83.91724 — do not pan below it
branches.water: the creek itself.
branches.note: National Forest from the source down to 34.79131, -83.91724. No gold record: this is a geological-inference test pan. Trout water (DNR stocks it April–Labor Day), so fishing rules apply.

branches.label: Coosa Backcountry Trail up over Locust Stake Gap to Calf Stomp Gap
branches.ends_at: Calf Stomp Gap (CBT / FS 108 / Roaring Fork Trail junction)
branches.water: none on the climb — fill 2 L each at WOLF-X.

branches.label: Coosa Backcountry Trail back down to the Vogel trailhead
branches.ends_at: Vogel State Park trailhead
branches.water: Wolf Creek near the park.
branches.note: Walk back to base camp instead of going up. Loses the hike.

branches.label: Calf Stomp Road (FS 108) and Big Grassy Knob Road out to the Bowers Road junction
branches.ends_at: Duncan Ridge Conn / Bowers Road junction — then 1.5 mi of Bowers Road to truck 2 at Owltown Gap
branches.water: none on the road — carry it.
branches.note: The fastest way off the ridge to a road a truck can meet you on, and it lands on the same exit the hike already uses. Forest roads: whether the gates are open is a ranger call (CALLS.md #1). This was the 2026-10-05 route that got dropped for walking roads — fine as a bail-out, not as the plan.

branches.label: Coosa Backcountry Trail on to the Calf Stump Branch camp
branches.ends_at: Calf Stump Branch camp (night 1)
branches.water: Calf Stump Branch at the camp (headwater; October flow UNCONFIRMED).

branches.label: Roaring Fork Trail west along the ridge to the drop-in
branches.ends_at: the leave-trail point above DROP-IN
branches.water: none on the ridge (3,300–3,500 ft) — carry it from Calf Stump Branch.
branches.note: OSM way 978262922, highway=path, surface=ground. No trail report, sign or Forest Service listing found: condition UNCONFIRMED. If it is gone, follow the ridge crest west by compass — same line.

branches.label: Coosa Backcountry Trail on around the loop (toward Coosa Bald / Wolfpen Gap)
branches.ends_at: 2.5 mi further round the Coosa Backcountry Trail loop
branches.water: creek crossings on the loop; none mapped on the first climb.
branches.note: The loop keeps going. This is the way to more trail and more ridge, not to a pan spot.

branches.label: Calf Stump Branch itself, up and down from the trail crossing
branches.ends_at: the branch (both ways from the crossing)
branches.water: the branch itself.
branches.note: No gold record for this branch and October flow is UNCONFIRMED. It is the camp water source — pan downstream of where you draw water.

branches.label: Back to Calf Stomp Gap, then FS 108 down to Big Grassy Knob Road
branches.ends_at: Big Grassy Knob Road (forest road; gate status UNCONFIRMED)
branches.water: Calf Stump Branch at the start; nothing after.
branches.note: Fastest way to a road a truck could meet you on, from night 1.

branches.label: Back up to Calf Stomp Gap for the Roaring Fork Trail
branches.ends_at: Calf Stomp Gap
branches.water: fill at Calf Stump Branch before leaving — nothing again until the creek at CAMP-U.
branches.note: The only retraced stretch on the whole hike.

branches.label: Up East Fork Coosa Creek past DROP-IN to the source
branches.ends_at: the mapped source of the East Fork (34.789953, -83.991496)
branches.water: the creek.
branches.note: The steep headwater reach, 350–720 ft/mi. Bulletin 19: up here the gold is in "the bed of the creek only" — bedrock cracks and the inside of bends, not banks.

branches.label: Down the creek to the LOWER reach
branches.water: the creek.
branches.note: Flatter, inside of bends. Still 500 m from the road end.

branches.label: Down East Fork Coosa Creek to where the road starts
branches.ends_at: the road end at 34.79824, -83.97825 (Duncan Ridge Conn)
branches.water: the creek, the whole way.
branches.note: The nearest point any vehicle can reach from CAMP-U. No path: walk the bed and banks.

branches.label: On down the creek to where the road starts
branches.ends_at: the road end at 34.79824, -83.97825
branches.water: the creek.
branches.note: Do not pan below 34.80637, -83.95980 — below that the East Fork is private.

branches.label: Duncan Ridge Conn down to the Bowers Road junction
branches.ends_at: the Duncan Ridge Conn / Bowers Road junction
branches.water: the creek runs beside the road most of the way.

branches.label: Roaring Fork, the next creek downstream
branches.ends_at: Roaring Fork
branches.water: the creek.
branches.note: Joins the East Fork at 34.801680, -83.967784. The survey calls a flat-after-steep reach plus a confluence the classic drop zone. Panning legality here is the same AMBER as the rest: no ranger has confirmed it.

branches.label: Bowers Road (FS 298) to Owltown Gap
branches.ends_at: Owltown Gap — truck 2
branches.water: none on the road.
branches.note: Bowers Road crosses private land between 34.8064 and Owltown Gap: public use of that stretch UNCONFIRMED, on the call list (CALLS.md #1).

branches.label: Jones Branch, the confluence just upstream
branches.ends_at: Jones Branch
branches.water: the branch.
branches.note: Joins the East Fork at 34.797713, -83.977594. Another flat-after-steep confluence. Check the private-land tint before you pan: the East Fork is private below 34.80637, -83.95980.

features.name: Bear Hair Gap Trail / Coosa Backcountry Trail
Trail to spring at White Oak Stomp

camps.name: Calf Stump Branch
camps.note: Night 1 water. Small headwater branch; October is the driest month and flow is UNCONFIRMED. Fill 2 L each at WOLF-X before the climb in case it is dry.

camps.name: East Fork Coosa Creek
camps.note: Night 2 water, about one creek-mile below the source at ~2,900 ft. Flow UNCONFIRMED. Fallback: move down toward 34.7958, -83.9792.

camps.name: West Fork Wolf Creek
camps.note: Last water a truck can reach. Fill 2 L each here — there is none on the 1,375 ft climb to Calf Stomp Gap.

trailhead_stores.label: WOLF-X — West Fork Wolf Creek / FS 107 crossing (CBT mile 3.37)
